messages:
Maya Kaur: Nightly import failed — NetSuite rejected rows with 'line_description too long'. We saw 2 duplicate Stripe drafts from retries. Dropping minimal context and ask for quick mitigation.

billing-runner-bot: [alert] billing-import-nightly job 1797654321 FAILED: NetSuiteImportError LINE_DESC_TOO_LONG batch=ns-batch-20260210-01

Omar Khan: Can you paste the invoice payload that's failing? Need to confirm which field is oversized.

Maya Kaur: sample payload (redacted):
{ "stripe_invoice_id": "in_9Abc...", "lines": [{ "description": "Pro plan  seats=150; notes={\"deploy\":\"prod:svc-13;commit=a1b2c3;trace=very-long-stack-trace...\"}" }] }

Sam R.: Root cause: recent debug change in usage-report started embedding full deploy metadata into line.description. NetSuite limit is 200 chars and the import retries cause Stripe drafts to be recreated.

Lina V.: Quick fix: truncate description to 180 chars before creating Stripe invoice lines and NetSuite CSV. Patch:

MAX=200
if len(desc)>MAX:
    desc = desc[:MAX-3] + "..."

Also move verbose data to invoice.metadata long-term.

Maya Kaur: I'll apply hotfix to staging and run import. If green, push to prod in the emergency window. Created ticket FIN-2026-411 and looped @Accounting.

billing-runner-bot: [info] billing-import-nightly job 1797654500 STARTED

Maya Kaur: Staging validated at 1797654475. Pushed to prod (deploy https://deploys.redwood/prod/15200). Prod run success at 1797654548. Voided 2 duplicate Stripe drafts. Accounting confirmed no revenue impact.

Ana Gomez: Please document root cause and remediation in FIN-2026-411, add CI test to validate description length, and assign owners. Thanks :thumbsup:
